Headline results for run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (PoroTomo DAS, Brady Hot Springs, March 2016):

RECORDS
- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20; 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z, 3.314% of the time window)
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57
- DAS detections: 62 detections in 53 records; relative b = 0.9849 (34 above the catalogue Mc)
- Pumping: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 over 15.96 days
- LBNL/NCEDC (GDR 859) catalogue, March 2016: 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07

CALIBRATED PROBABILITY (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5; magnitudes calibrated against the LBNL catalogue):
  b      Sigma      P(M>=5.5)/yr   P(M>=5.5) for observed volume   P(M>=3)/yr
  1.0    -5.449     0.0001198      5.236e-06                      0.03719
  0.73   -5.319     0.004922       0.0002155                      0.2809
  0.65   -5.281     0.01474        0.0006484                      0.4653

DAS-BASED UPPER BOUND (uncalibrated magnitudes; every DAS detection counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it OVER-COUNTS):
  b = 0.9849, Sigma = -2.698, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842

Interpretation: The calibrated catalogue-based numbers are the LBNL-calibrated estimates (Sigma ~ -5.3 to -5.4, P(Mw>=5.5) of ~1.2e-4 to ~1.5e-2 per year depending on b). The DAS-based figure (P(Mw>=5.5) ~ 0.078/yr at b = 0.9849) is an upper bound only, because DAS magnitudes are uncalibrated and all 62 detections are treated as events at/above Mc, inflating the count. A Pohang-like Mw>=5.5 event is therefore unlikely under the calibrated model but cannot be excluded by the DAS upper bound.
